data.intro: TabMerger stores all data locally in IndexedDB. Cloud sync requires a Pro account.

ai.intro: Every AI action below draws from the same monthly AI quota (see Account tab). Turn off features you don't use to save quota for the ones you do.
ai.nameGroupDescription: Suggest a name for a group or window with AI

ai.suggestSessionsDescription: Background banner suggesting when to save a session
ai.summariesDescription: AI summary on tab hover preview
ai.throttleLabel: Limit automatic AI suggestions to once a day
ai.throttleDescription: The background suggest-sessions banner fires at most once per day to protect your monthly AI quota. AI actions you trigger manually (Auto-group, Name group, Organize) are never limited by this.

plan.managed: TabMerger handles setup — {{remaining}} of {{cap}} credits left this month
plan.byok: You added your own {{provider}} API key

provider.label: AI provider
provider.description: Pick the company that issued your API key.

key.label: Your {{provider}} API key
